back: Structural: codes for a functional protein (e.g. enzyme). Regulatory: codes for a protein controlling other genes (e.g. repressor).
Inducible: made when substrate present (β-galactosidase). Repressible: switched off when product accumulates.
Promoter, operator, lacZ, lacY, lacA (regulatory gene lacI separate, with its own promoter).
Repressor binds operator; RNA polymerase blocked; no transcription.
Lactose binds repressor; shape changes; it leaves the operator; structural genes transcribed.
A protein that binds DNA near a promoter to increase or decrease transcription of a gene.
Gibberellin + receptor → DELLA broken down → transcription factor freed → growth or amylase genes transcribed.
